sovereign_country.strategic_role: 极速离岸证券与外汇交易商持牌（VFSC）、轻资产免税出海

business_scope.primary_industry_name: Passive Holding of Subsidiary Shares and Corporate Dividends

meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Hybrid (English common law and French civil law, with customary law preserved where applicable)
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: Pacific Agreement on Closer Economic Relations Plus (PACER Plus)

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: International Companies Act [Cap. 222], as amended by the International Companies (Amendment) Act 2012, together with the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission Act [Cap. 235], the Anti-Money Laundering Act [Cap. 287], the Vanuatu Financial Intelligence Unit regulations, and VFSC Beneficial Ownership Guidance and Enforcement Manual; UBO records must be maintained by the licensed registered agent and filed with the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission and are accessible to the Vanuatu Financial Intelligence Unit, the State Law Office and other competent authorities.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarized copy of passport of each statutory shareholder, director and ultimate beneficial owner
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Passport authority / notary public in the owner's jurisdiction
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Consular Legalization (notarization, authentication by the originating government, then legalization by a Vanuatu Consular or Diplomatic Mission or the Vanuatu Ministry of Foreign Affairs)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Bank reference letter / bank customer due diligence certificate confirming account conduct and source of wealth
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: International or local commercial bank holding the applicant's account
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Consular Legalization (bank acknowledgement notarized and authenticated; apostille only where the bank's jurisdiction is a Contracting State to the Hague Apostille Convention)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of incorporation and certificate of good standing of each corporate UBO and proxy shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Company registrar or registered agent in the jurisdiction of incorporation of the corporate UBO
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille if the jurisdiction of incorporation is a Contracting State, otherwise Consular Legalization

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Memorandum and articles of association / constitutional documents of corporate UBOs evidencing ownership chain
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Corporate secretary or registered agent of the corporate UBO
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille or Consular Legalization as applicable to the corporate UBO's jurisdiction

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Executed power of attorney and registered agent engagement letter
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Ultimate beneficial owner and licensed Vanuatu registered agent
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Notarization and, where required, consular legalization in the country of execution

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory enhanced due diligence on every identified UBO, director, shareholder and authorized signatory against (i) OFAC Specially Designated Nationals and Blocked Persons List; (ii) United Nations Security Council Consolidated Sanctions List; (iii) UK HM Treasury consolidated sanctions list; (iv) Australian DFAT consolidated lists; and (v) Vanuatu domestic criminal, regulatory and financial intelligence unit watchlists. PEP status, whether foreign or domestic, triggers senior management approval, documented source-of-wealth and source-of-funds evidence, and ongoing transaction monitoring. Negative screening results must be documented and retained for at least five years after termination of the business relationship.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) online e-Registry portal for company and international company name clearance
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: All company names must be expressed in Latin script; where a proposed name is derived from a non-Latin script, a statutory transliteration into English, French or Bislama must accompany the VFSC application. The name of a Vanuatu International Company must end with 'Limited', 'Corporation', 'Incorporated' or an approved abbreviation such as 'Ltd', 'Corp' or 'Inc'. Names must not be identical or confusingly similar to an existing registered entity.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: If VFSC rejects a proposed name, the applicant must file a written reconsideration request addressed to the Registrar of International Companies within 14 calendar days of the notice, identifying the statutory basis of objection and supplying a corrected proposed name or legal argument distinguishing it from the conflicting entity. VFSC shall provide a decision within 15 business days. An adverse final decision may be challenged by filing an originating application for judicial review in the Supreme Court of Vanuatu under the Judicial Review Rules, naming the VFSC Registrar as respondent.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: A virtual or mail-forwarding service alone is not permissible as the statutory registered office of an International Company; the licensed Vanuatu registered agent must maintain a physical registered office in Vanuatu for service of process and statutory notices. Remote administrative and virtual secretarial support may complement, but cannot replace, the physical statutory office.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: 15% annual probability of unannounced VFSC inspection at the registered agent or registered office level; less than 5% probability of an unannounced physical inspection at the SPV's business location because a pure passive equity holding company has no physical trading premises.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: International Companies Act, Cap 222 (Vanuatu), ss. 5-12 (Incorporation), s. 13 (Prohibited and restricted business), ss. 35-38 (Memorandum and Articles), s. 51 (Registered office and registered agent), ss. 60-66 (Directors and officers)
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) — International Companies Registry, Port Vila, Republic of Vanuatu
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Memorandum and Articles of Association (Constitution) together with Application for Registration as an International Company and Consent of the Registered Agent
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No minimum paid-up capital prescribed under Cap 222; authorized capital typically set at USD 50,000 and issued capital may be as low as USD 1 or 1,000 no-par value shares; no escrow account or capital contribution deposit is required at formation
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED THAT: 1. The subscribers to the Memorandum and Articles of Association be and are hereby confirmed as the first directors of the Company, and the Company's registration as an International Company under the International Companies Act Cap 222 of Vanuatu is ratified. 2. The registered office and registered agent be and are hereby adopted, being [Registered Agent Name] of Port Vila, Vanuatu. 3. The issuance of 1,000 ordinary shares of no par value to the sole shareholder be and is hereby approved. 4. [Name] be and is hereby appointed as Director and [Name] as Secretary, each with full authority to execute all documents and effect all filings required for the Company's passive equity holding mandate.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: VFSC International Companies Registry (submitted online via licensed registered agent)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit two to three proposed corporate names ending with 'Limited' or 'Ltd' through the appointed VFSC-licensed registered agent. The agent verifies name availability against the VFSC corporate register and files a name reservation request. Provide a short affidavit or digital confirmation of beneficial ownership details together with the name application to satisfy the agent's KYC duties.
required_dossiers: Name reservation application form
Passport copy of beneficial owner and subscriber
Bank or professional reference letter for KYC
Beneficial ownership declaration
Registered agent engagement letter
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the proposed name is refused or flagged as undesirable, the registered agent resubmits with alternative names from the original list at no additional state fee; a fresh application is lodged within 5 business days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Drafting, Execution, and Notarization of Constitution
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Licensed Vanuatu registered agent with notarial attestation by a Vanuatu notary public or qualified foreign notary
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The registered agent drafts the Memorandum and Articles of Association using the VFSC standard form adapted for a pure equity holding SPV. The subscriber(s) execute the Constitution in counterpart, with signatures witnessed and notarized. Each director and the secretary provide a signed consent to act. If the subscriber is a corporate entity, certified extracts of the parent board resolution are annexed.
required_dossiers: Executed Memorandum and Articles of Association
Consent to act as first director (Form D)
Consent to act as secretary (Form S)
Consent of registered agent
Notarized copy of subscriber's identity document
Certified extract of corporate subscriber's board resolution (if applicable)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the VFSC rejects the Constitution for technical defects, the agent amends the defective clauses and re-executes a conformed copy; no re-notarization is required where the defect is purely typographical and endorsed by the notary.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Submission of Registration Application and Payment of State Fees
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: VFSC International Companies Registry — Companies Registration Desk
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The registered agent files the executed Constitution together with the Application for Registration, consents, and beneficial ownership schedule in electronic and hard copy. The standard government filing fee of USD 300 (exclusive of VAT and agency fees) is remitted via the VFSC approved payment rails. The application must confirm the SPV's compliance with s. 13 of Cap 222 (no business with Vanuatu residents and no regulated activities).
required_dossiers: Signed Application for Registration as an International Company
Memorandum and Articles of Association (filed copy)
Consents of directors, secretary, and registered agent
Beneficial ownership register extract
Declaration of no business in Vanuatu (s. 13 compliance)
Payment confirmation of USD 300 state fee
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Where the Registrar issues a requisition, the agent has 14 calendar days to respond with additional information or corrected documents; in the absence of response, the application lapses and can be reinstated by filing a fresh application with an additional fee of USD 150.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Issuance of Certificate of Incorporation and Post-Formation Instruments
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Upon approval, the Registrar issues the Certificate of Incorporation under seal. The registered agent then prepares the company seal, register of members, share certificates for the issued no-par value shares, and the certified true copy of the Constitution. The certificate date is the legal date of incorporation for the SPV.
required_dossiers: Certificate of Incorporation (issued by VFSC)
Company seal
Share certificates (1,000 ordinary shares to sole shareholder)
Register of members and register of directors
Certified copy of Constitution
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Certificate contains a clerical error in the company number or name, a written request for rectification under s. 20 of Cap 222 is filed with the Registrar; correction is completed within 3 business days without additional fee.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Adoption of First Board Resolution and Opening of Corporate Records
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Board of Directors and VFSC-licensed registered agent (corporate records custodian)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The first board meeting is held (by written resolution) adopting the pro-forma First Board Resolution covering share subscription, registered office adoption, and officer appointments. The board resolves to open the statutory registers and to authorize the execution of the subscription agreement for the target subsidiary. The resolution is recorded in the minute book maintained at the registered agent's office; no public filing of the resolution is required under Cap 222.
required_dossiers: First Board Resolution (written)
Minute book and share transfer ledger
Register of charges (if any)
Subsidiary share subscription agreement draft
Bank account resolution and mandate (for swift wire rails)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If a director contests the written resolution, a physical board meeting is convened on 48 hours' notice; in the alternative, a unanimous shareholder written consent in lieu of a board meeting may be adopted to remove any ambiguity.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Not applicable — no industrial licensing regime attaches to a passive equity holding SPV; VFSC retains supervisory jurisdiction over International Companies under Cap 222 and the Vanuatu Investment Promotion Authority (VIPA) registration is required only if the entity later conducts physical business in Vanuatu
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Not required — the SPV's mandate is limited to passive holding of subsidiary shares and collection of dividends; a Vanuatu business license (under the Business License Act) is expressly not required for a duly registered International Company that does not carry on business with Vanuatu residents (s. 13, Cap 222)

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Department of Environmental Protection and Conservation (DEPC), Ministry of Climate Change, Adaptation, Meteorology and Geo-Hazards, Vanuatu
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt — the entity is a paper-only holding SPV with no physical development, construction, manufacturing, or extractive activity; therefore no EIA registration, preliminary assessment, or full EIA report is required under the Environmental Impact Assessment Regulations
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: N/A — zero operational footprint; no wastewater discharge, VOC emissions, hazardous waste generation, or stationary combustion sources; the SPV holds no land, plant, or equipment and produces no regulated environmental waste stream

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Not applicable — the SPV maintains no physical premises, employees, or industrial plant; fire safety certification, structural load inspection, and worksite occupational clearance are waived; the only physical address is the registered agent's office in Port Vila, which holds its own valid business and occupancy permits

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Vanuatu Revenue Authority (VRA), Ministry of Finance and Economic Management; official portal: https://www.vra.gov.vu
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: International Companies incorporated under the International Companies Act (Cap 222) are statutorily exempt from domestic income tax and therefore do not obtain a corporate TIN. If the IC voluntarily elects or becomes required to register for VAT (e.g., by undertaking chargeable supplies in Vanuatu), it must submit the VAT registration application (Form VAT-01) to the Vanuatu Revenue Authority, accompanied by the certificate of incorporation, registered office address, director and shareholder particulars, local registered agent attestation, and bank account details, after which a VRA VAT registration number is issued. No corporate tax identification number exists because Vanuatu levies no corporate income tax.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No local check-the-box or hybrid mismatch election exists under Vanuatu law. An International Company is statutorily treated as a non-resident exempt entity within Vanuatu's tax-exempt zone. The entity may, however, be classified for foreign tax purposes under the relevant foreign jurisdiction's check-the-box rules (e.g., U.S. Form 8832), but such election has no Vanuatu domestic tax effect.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: Value Added Tax (VAT) under the Value Added Tax Act [Cap 239]
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: VT 5,000,000 annual taxable turnover (compulsory registration threshold); voluntary registration permitted below this threshold
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Vanuatu has no real-time fiscal clearance regime, no API-based e-invoicing clearance, and no digital stamping requirement. VAT-registered businesses must issue VAT invoices in the prescribed format and file periodic VAT returns electronically via the Vanuatu Revenue Authority's e-services portal, but no State-coded QR or centralized invoice clearance is currently mandated.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Goods are eligible for zero-rated VAT when they are exported from Vanuatu under a valid customs export declaration and the exporter retains evidence of physical removal from Vanuatu within the prescribed period. Services are zero-rated when supplied to a non-resident person who is outside Vanuatu at the time of supply, the service is not used or consumed in Vanuatu, and the supply does not relate to land or goods situated in Vanuatu. An International Company engaged solely in passive equity holding generally supplies no local taxable supplies and is outside the scope of Vanuatu VAT; zero-rating applies only to VAT-registered persons undertaking qualifying export supplies.
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: Fraudulent or improper zero-rating claims and export VAT refunds are subject to the Vanuatu Revenue Authority's audit scrutiny, retrospective assessment, and recovery for up to five years. Penalties under the Value Added Tax Act include monetary penalties of up to 200% of the tax evaded, criminal fines, imprisonment of directors and officers, mandatory revocation of VAT registration, and civil clawback of all refund amounts plus interest. The Vanuatu Financial Services Commission may additionally restrict or cancel an International Company's license if tax fraud or misrepresentation is established.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The Vanuatu vatu (VUV) is not subject to exchange controls; the capital and current accounts are fully liberalized. Dividends, interest, and profit remittances by non-resident International Company shareholders are freely transferable in any convertible currency. The only de facto hurdle is the documentary burden imposed by commercial banks for anti-money-laundering (AML) counterparty due diligence; there is no regulatory exchange-recognition barrier. In practice, the RBV does not require prior approval for dividend distributions or share-capital repatriation by International Companies, although the transacting bank must verify the corporate status and tax-exempt notation of the IC.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Vanuatu maintains no statutory mandate requiring export receivables to be surrendered, converted, or repatriated within any timeline. There is no compulsory rate of mandatory conversion for export proceeds; approved commercial banks may credit foreign-currency export proceeds directly to the exporter's foreign-currency account. Statutory reporting obligations relate to the Reserve Bank's balance-of-payments data collection only, not to surrender or conversion ratios.

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Feasibility: Limited for a Vanuatu International Company. Offshore digital EMIs generally refuse pure holding vehicles because they cannot independently verify economic substance and the jurisdiction's OFC profile raises correspondent-banking risk. Only a small number of EMI platforms under a full European EMI licence may accept a Vanuatu IC if the IC provides audited financial statements, a transactional rationale for the account, and a signed beneficial-ownership declaration. Legal constraints include absence of a local EMI licensing framework under Vanuatu law and a ban on engaging in domestic banking business without a banking licence, so the EMI must remain a wholly non-resident service provider.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: An in-person identity interview at the Vanuatu branch is the presumptive standard for all non-resident signatories. Physical attendance can be waived only where (i) the bank obtains a remote video certification endorsed by an authorised Vanuatu registered agent, (ii) the director's passport is notarised/apostilled in the home jurisdiction, and (iii) a local notary public in Vanuatu countersigns the applicant's signature. Without one of these conditions, the account opening will be rejected.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Beneficial ownership veil on an International Company
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Certified copy of the VFSC International Company certificate, the constitution and memorandum, a complete group-structure chart tracing every natural-person UBO to the ultimate beneficiary, a signed Declaration of Trust / Declaration of Beneficial Ownership, government-issued photo identification and proof of address for each UBO, and a waiver letter from the Vanuatu registered agent accepting responsibility for maintaining the beneficial-ownership register.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Mixed funding in the initial capital injection and absent source-of-wealth record
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Twelve months of bank statements of the sending entity/originator, the share subscription agreement or board resolution evidencing the equity injection, audited financial statements or management accounts showing the source of the remitted funds, a notarised source-of-wealth affidavit, and confirmation of the tax identification number of each contributing party.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Application profile matching a 'mailbox-like' passive shell with no real presence
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: A dated and executed board resolution authorising the bank in Vanuatu as the sole operational treasury account, a written commercial rationale for holding the account in Vanuatu, a lease agreement for a virtual office/secretarial suite or a physical Singapore/Vanuatu trust-company office arrangement, and a written confirmation from a licensed Vanuatu registered agent that the IC will not conduct active trade in the Republic except for the passive holding of shares and collection of dividends.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Confusion with licensed financial activities triggering VFSC licensing concerns
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: A statutory declaration that the SPV does not fall under the category of 'Bank, Financial Institution, or Insurance Business' as defined by the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission Act; a negative-licensing opinion from local counsel; and a letter from the bank's compliance department confirming that the account will be classified as an 'operational treasury account' rather than a regulated financial-services account.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Inbound capital contributions should be routed as SWIFT MT103 wires from the parent entity's bank account to the VU IC's account held with a licensed Vanuatu bank. The remitter must enter in field /70 (Remittance Information) the narrative 'EQUITY CAPITAL CONTRIBUTION' and in field /56/F the SWIFT/BIC of the Vanuatu receiving bank. The Vanuatu bank will not require prior exchange-control approval, but the sender's bank may apply a purpose code for foreign-direct investment statistical purposes, typically 'G30' under the IMF Balance of Payments classification. Before crediting, the Vanuatu receiving bank will validate that the IC is not under liquidation and will request a board resolution, the share certificate, and the UBO declaration to distinguish the injection from an incoming loan.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Trade settlements and dividend outflows must be executed via SWIFT MT103 on a T+0/T+1 basis, using the Vanuatu IC's designated foreign-currency clearing accounts with the local correspondent network. For documentary trade where the IC is a purchaser under a commercial invoice, a commercial letter of credit (documentary LC) can be issued through a Vanuatu commercial bank or, more efficiently, through a Pacific regional issuing bank (e.g., BSP, ANZ) with reimbursement under SWIFT MT700. Due to the IC being tax-exempt, outbound dividends are also cleared by MT103; the bank will obtain a distribution statement and a solvency test to prevent an unauthorised reduction of capital. Bulk settlement for multiple subsidiary dividend receipts may be netted via a Nostro concentration account during the same value day.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Onshore deliverable Vanuatu vatu forward contracts against USD, AUD, or NZD

Non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) referencing the VUV/USD cross-rate only if the vendor bank is an authorised dealer in a foreign market and the contract is documented over-the-counter in accordance with ISDA
Cross-currency swaps between VUV and the funding currency (USD/EUR/AUD) for long-term liability transformation
Vanuatu-dollar vanilla foreign-exchange options for hedging dividend receipts and dividend distributions

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Return of the International Company
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Filing within 30 days of the anniversary of incorporation; calendar year not imposed.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing penalty of approximately USD 50 per month or part thereof after the 30-day grace period; continued default for 3 months may lead to strike-off from the Companies Register.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Beneficial Ownership Confirmation and Register Update
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Submitted with the Annual Return within 30 days of the anniversary of incorporation; must also be updated within 14 days of any ownership change.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Non-compliance with UBO declaration requirements is an offence; VFSC may impose financial penalties and the entity may be removed from the register at the discretion of the Registrar.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Registered Agent and Registered Office Confirmation
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually on the anniversary of incorporation; a change of agent or registered office must be filed by way of notice within 21 days.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to maintain a valid registered agent and registered office is a continuing default under the International Companies Act; may result in suspension of the company's certificate of incorporation and eventual administrative strike-off.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Government and Registry Recurring Fee Settlement
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Payment due on or before 1 January each calendar year or on the anniversary date if registered mid-year.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Unpaid annual fees accrue interest of 5% per month; prolonged non-payment is a ground for administrative deregistration and dissolution of the International Company.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Under Vanuatu International Companies Act, a standard International Company acting as a pure equity-holding SPV is not required to commission an independent audit. A statutory audit becomes compulsory if the company is listed, public, holds a regulated financial services licence, is subject to a consolidation requirement by a parent entity under IFRS, or if members representing 10% or more of voting rights request an audit.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: International Financial Reporting Standards (IFRS) as adopted by the Vanuatu Institute of Chartered Accountants; simple-receipts internal accounts permitted for a non-trading private holding SPV.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: The registered agent must keep a Beneficial Ownership Register and file an annual confirmation of beneficial ownership together with the Annual Return. Any transfer of shares or change in the ultimate beneficial owner must be notified to the registered agent for updating, and the VFSC must receive an updated confirmation within 14 days of the change. A physical board minute book and statutory registers must be maintained at the registered office or at an alternative location disclosed to the VFSC.

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 1,200 - USD 2,500 per year for registered agent, registered office and annual secretarial work
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 0 for standard exempt private SPV; USD 4,500 - USD 7,500 if an audit is voluntarily or parent-consolidation-required

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 0% – Vanuatu imposes no corporate income tax. No national income tax, no capital gains tax, no branch profits tax, and no inheritance or estate duty is levied on International Companies (ICs).
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Full statutory tax exemption for International Companies under the International Companies Act (Cap. 222). ICs are tax-exempt zone entities; they are exempt from all Vanuatu income tax and business license taxes for income derived outside Vanuatu. No payroll tax applies. The only recurring state levies are the VFSC annual license fee and the annual registered agent fee, both calculated on authorized share capital, not on profit.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: No Vanuatu corporate income tax return is prescribed. The annual compliance obligation for an IC is the VFSC Annual Return filed by the licensed Registered Agent through the VFSC Online portal (https://vfsconline.vu) pursuant to s. 92 of the International Companies Act (Cap. 222).
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Annual Return must be delivered to the Registrar of International Companies within one month after the return date, being the anniversary of incorporation. The annual VFSC license fee is simultaneously payable on the anniversary date; a grace period is granted by the VFSC fee schedule before late penalties accrue.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Registered legal name of the International Company as evidenced on the certificate of incorporation.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Must match exactly the VFSC certificate; non-resident owners cannot alter the name without a resolution and VFSC approval.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Unique 8-digit VFSC International Company registration number (e.g. 1234567).
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Retain for all correspondence and wire instruction references; non-resident directors must cite it in banking KYC.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Physical address of the licensed registered office in Port Vila or Luganville, maintained by the Registered Agent.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: A pure equity holding SPV must not relocate registered office outside Vanuatu; offshore directors must notify the agent of any change within 14 days.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Licensed VFSC service provider (law firm, trust company, or corporate services firm) responsible for statutory filing.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The non-resident beneficial owner must execute a power of attorney in favor of the agent and disclose the UBO in the agent's VFSC-supervised beneficial ownership register.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Full names, addresses, and nationality of all directors and the register of members, including share classes and nominal value.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Nominee directors and shareholders must be disclosed to the Registered Agent; the VFSC beneficial ownership regime requires filing of ultimate natural person owners with the agent, not a public register.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Statement of authorized capital and issued capital used to compute the VFSC annual license fee tier.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Capital is typically USD-denominated (e.g. USD 1,000 authorized); no minimum capital is required, but undercapitalization of the SPV may be scrutinized by creditor jurisdictions.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 7 – Declaration of No Local Business
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Statutory declaration that the IC has not carried on business with Vanuatu residents and has not held an interest in real property located in Vanuatu, preserving its exempt IC status.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: A pure equity holding SPV must avoid local trading activity; incidental local expenditures (legal, agent fees) are permissible but must be disclosed.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing of the VFSC Annual Return attracts escalating late filing fees imposed by VFSC (per month or part thereof). Late payment of the annual license fee triggers a surcharge (typically 10% of the fee). Persistent default (12 months) exposes the IC to administrative strike-off and dissolution under s. 92(4) of the International Companies Act, with restoration costing additional court fees and regulator penalties. False declarations render the registered agent liable as well.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: No municipal Business License is required for an International Company conducting only offshore passive holding. The Business License regime under the Business Licences Regulations is expressly disapplied to ICs while they remain in the exempt zone; a municipal license becomes mandatory if a local entity carries on business in Vanuatu.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Annual municipal license renewal (if any incidental local activity is admitted) follows the calendar year or the municipal council's fiscal year; ICs that remain purely passive are not subject to renewal and require no payment.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: International Company passive equity holding; exempted by operation of law.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The non-resident owner should obtain a written exemption confirmation from the Registered Agent to present to Vanuatu banking and foreign correspondent banks.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: If the IC acquires any Vanuatu-situs asset (real estate, local subsidiary operating onshore, or employment), the exemption is lost and the IC must register under the Business Licences Act and pay license fees.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Do not route Vanuatu-situs revenue or employment through the SPV; that would trigger the municipal business license and expose the SPV to local taxation.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Failure to obtain a municipal license when required results in fines under the Business Licences Regulations and daily continuing penalties, plus director liability for revenue evasion.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 0% – Vanuatu levies no withholding tax on dividends paid by an International Company to any shareholder, whether resident in Vanuatu or non-resident. Dividends, distributions, and returns of capital are entirely free of Quellensteuer at source. Consequently, a pure equity holding SPV's dividend upstream to its non-resident parent is untaxed in Vanuatu.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: Vanuatu maintains no comprehensive double taxation agreements (DTAs) that would reduce withholding taxes, because the domestic withholding rate is already zero. Vanuatu has only limited tax information exchange agreements (TIEAs) (e.g. with Australia) for administrative assistance. A non-resident shareholder claiming treaty protection from its own residence jurisdiction cannot invoke a Vanuatu DTA; instead, the shareholder applies for foreign tax credit or parent-subsidiary relief in its home jurisdiction. Vanuatu does not issue a tax residence certificate (TRC) to ICs for income tax purposes because ICs are not income-tax resident; a Certificate of Incorporation and a VFSC Good Standing certificate serve as the only documentary evidence for cross-border equity holders. Expected protocol steps: (1) obtain Certificate of Good Standing from VFSC; (2) present to the home jurisdiction tax authority for participation exemption or indirect credit; (3) complete an HMRC/IRS/ATO form as applicable based on Vanuatu zero-rate proof.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Statutory rate: 0% for cross-border royalties and 0% for interest paid by an IC. No interest or royalty limitation rules apply at IC level; a Vanuatu IC may pay license fees, management fees, or interest to a foreign parent with zero source-state deduction. In the absence of DTAs, no reduced treaty rate is applicable; the 0% statutory rate is absolute.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: N/A – No local currency threshold. Vanuatu's Income Tax Act has no transfer pricing documentation, Local File, or Master File requirements, and no country-by-country reporting obligation is imposed on International Companies. The VUV threshold triggering transfer pricing documentation is nil because the obligation does not legally exist; nevertheless, foreign parent jurisdictions (ASX-listed parents, OECD jurisdictions) may require global Master File inclusion.
approved_arm_length_methodologies: Profit Split Method (including value-based and residual analysis)
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: The Vanuatu Economic Substance Regulations (ESR) No. 9 of 2019, effective 1 July 2019, apply to entities carrying core income-generating activities in defined 'relevant activities'. A pure equity holding SPV (ISIC 6420) that derives income exclusively from dividends and capital gains on shares of subsidiaries is NOT a 'relevant activity' for ESR purposes and is therefore not subject to the economic substance test. The company remains subject to the minimum substance baseline: (a) a physical registered office in Vanuatu; (b) a licensed resident Registered Agent; (c) adequate books and records maintained in Vanuatu; and (d) compliance with the IC Act, the AML/CFT regime, and the VFSC beneficial ownership filing. Caution: if the SPV later converts part of its activity to intra-group financing, leasing, or intellectual property holding, ESR full substance requirements (board meetings in Vanuatu, adequate premises, full-time employees, and operational expenditure in Vanuatu) will apply to the relevant income, and the SPV would be required to file an annual ESR return with the VFSC.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Tax Evasion Facilitation – Offshore Conduit Abuse
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Operating a Vanuatu IC as a sham conduit to interpose zero-tax income between a profitable operating subsidiary and a high-tax ultimate parent without any economic substance, or deliberately misrepresenting to foreign tax authorities that Vanuatu IC income is untaxable while the IC is in fact managed from abroad for the purpose of evading source-country income tax.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Vanuatu has no income tax offence, but the VFSC may impose administrative penalties, strike off the company and refer to Vanuatu Police for offences of fraudulent misrepresentation under ss. 92 and 110 of the International Companies Act (Cap. 222). Foreign tax authorities can invoke exchange of information under TIEAs, reassess the parent with penal interest, and impose civil penalties equivalent to 100-200% of the underpaid tax.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who knowingly signed false statutory declarations or aided foreign tax evasion face personal civil restitution orders, confiscation of assets, director disqualification by VFSC, and in egregious cases extradition risk to the source jurisdiction; Vanuatu courts can also impose imprisonment under the Penal Code for conspiracy to defraud.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Abuse of Corporate Personality / Shell Company Misrepresentation
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Using the SPV to hold bank accounts and wires for a third party with no genuine equity participation, or structuring with fully bearer-share characteristics despite the VFSC UBO registry requirement, thereby creating a 'letterbox' or 'off-the-shelf shell' profile that lacks any demonstrable commercial nexus.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Under the Vanuatu International Companies Act, non-compliant bearer share issuance is prohibited; VFSC may strike off the company, refuse to renew the registered agent's license, and report to the Financial Intelligence Unit. Financial institutions will freeze Swift wire transactions as suspicious; the entity is flagged under enhanced due diligence.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and nominee shareholders risk being held personally liable for all company liabilities on a piercing-of-the-veil theory in the jurisdictions where the foreign subsidiary creditors suffer loss; travel bans and asset freezing orders are commonly issued by foreign courts against nominee directors of shell SPVs.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: AML/CFT Violations – Beneficial Ownership and Money Laundering
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Failure to file or update the beneficial ownership register with the Registered Agent under the Vanuatu AML/CFT framework (Supervision Act applying to VFSC-licensed agents), omission of suspicious transaction reporting to the Vanuatu Financial Intelligence Unit, or moving illicit proceeds through the SPV's interbank Swift rails, thereby triggering predicate offences under the Money Laundering and Financing of Terrorism Act 2020.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: The VFSC may levy administrative fines on the Registered Agent and the company, and the Vanuatu courts may impose criminal fines and custodial sentences for money laundering for natural persons; the SPV is additionally subject to immediate account termination by correspondent banks and a recommendation for listing by the FATF.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who are the controlling minds of a shell SPV that launders proceeds face imprisonment under the ML/FT Act; the Personal liability extends to civil confiscation of all assets traceable to the offending account; directors are also exposed to personal travel bans imposed by foreign AML authorities and to regulatory disqualification across VFSC and overseas registries.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: False Statements to VFSC and Non-Response to EOI
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Knowingly making a false statement in the VFSC Annual Return or failing to respond to a legitimate Exchange of Information request initiated by the Vanuatu Competent Authority (Ministry of Trade) concerning the ultimate parent's tax status; this includes concealing the existence of an active subsidiary in a blacklisted jurisdiction.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: False statements are an offence under s. 99 of the International Companies Act (Cap. 222), punishable upon conviction by a fine not exceeding VUV 250,000 and imprisonment for up to two years. Failure to produce records to an EOI request can trigger deregistration and loss of the IC's legal personality.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors are personally criminally liable for the false declaration, incurring fines and terms of imprisonment; the VFSC may also issue personal recovery orders against directors for regulator costs and professional compensation; repeated non-compliance also results in the jurisdiction's re-listing on the EU non-cooperative list and subsequent collapse of all correspondent banking access.
